verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe escalation policies as custom rules defining who is alerted and in what order, continuing until acknowledged, with time-based escalation (e.g., on-call person notified first, escalates to whole team after 3 minutes if unacknowledged) and support for complex rules based on time, team availability, and incident origin, plus multi-timezone schedules for coverage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 'fallback responders' terminology or repeat/looping rounds beyond one escalation step, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
